question: When does a hard weight session actually build muscle: during the lifting, or in the day after?
answer: In the day after. MacDougall and colleagues measured muscle protein building after heavy arm training: it was up about 50% after four hours, more than double its usual rate at 24 hours, and nearly back to normal by 36. The session sends the signal; the following day does the construction.
move: Count the time after the effort as part of the work.
ask: Do I treat rest as wasted time, when it may be where my gains are made?
source: MacDougall et al., Can J Appl Physiol, 1995
reference: MacDougall et al., The time course for elevated muscle protein synthesis following heavy resistance exercise, Canadian Journal of Applied Physiology, 1995
